Actually no tool named get_fuel_level. But we have displayCarStatus with option "fuel" or "battery". So we can call displayCarStatus with option "fuel" to get fuel level. Also we have get_vehicle_mileage? Not listed. But we have estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage(distance). That estimates feasibility based on mileage. But we might need to get current mileage? There's no tool for that. But we can use estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage(distance) to see if feasible. But we also need to check fuel level. We can call displayCarStatus with option "fuel". Then we can call estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage(distance=750). That will give us feasibility. Then we can display logs. Let's do that.
